steps.task: Open the supplied TaskRecord, inspect the workspace, and checkpoint INSPECTING. Return AgentResult JSON and do not modify anything.

logs.task: Open the supplied TaskRecord. Find the relevant failure log and first actionable error. Read-only; do not change the shared phase.

metadata.task: Open the supplied TaskRecord. Investigate variables, active appends, tasks and dependencies. Read-only/offline; do not change the shared phase.

standards.task: Open the supplied TaskRecord. Review relevant files for standards/reproducibility. Read-only; do not change the shared phase.

reducer.task: Open the supplied TaskRecord. Merge branches, checkpoint their typed Evidence, define the verification contract, and checkpoint PLANNING with the root cause, exact next action and resume action. Do not claim a fix was executed.
